item.title: Can Lena's Dunham new Girls do for 40-year-olds what she did for 23-year-olds? I know it can | Rhiannon Lucy Cosslett
item.description: I was in my early 20s when the classic series debuted and I recognised so much. I can’t wait to see how the reboot takes on a new – equally messy – stage of life HBO’s Girls is coming back, Lena Dunham and her fellow cast members announced this week, and the internet is already abuzz. Women of a certain age, myself included – approaching, turning or having turned 40 – are genuinely thrilled, if also slightly trepidatious. When you’ve loved, loathed and most importantly grown with characters in the way many of us did with Girls, you feel protective of a show’s legacy. item.title: Inside Meryl Streep’s former five-storey New York townhouse built in 1845
item.description: Meryl Streep’s former Greenwich Village townhouse, built in 1845, combines historic architecture with luxury features, including six fireplaces, six bedrooms and a rooftop garden. The three-time Oscar winner owned the five-storey New York property from 1995 to 2005. In 2016, it returned to the market with its asking price reduced to $28.5 million.
